title: kate-core: drop a boundary bonus after a letter
summary: A fuzzy boundary bonus skips a previous letter or digit. An accented letter is a letter. The fullwidth score in the existing test changes from 55 to 47. The test goes in the existing fuzzy tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fuzzy.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only the Some arm of boundary_bonus. The condition is !ch.is_alphanumeric(). Index 0 still returns 8. Some(_) still returns 0. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch fuzzy_match, next_index, same_fold, score_one, gap_adjust, camel_bonus, or digit_hump. Update the doc sentence on fuzzy_match. The old sentence says a later scalar adds 8 when the previous scalar is not ASCII alphanumeric. The new sentence says a later scalar adds 8 when the previous scalar is not a letter or a digit. You may update that sentence. Update the score 55 in a_fullwidth_digit_hump_adds_eight to 47. The a2B assert in that test stays 47. Do not change any other number in that test. The existing tests foo_bar_scores_the_documented_hits, a_camel_hump_adds_eight, a_digit_hump_adds_eight, and a_lower_letter_after_a_digit_adds_eight stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_letter_after_an_accented_letter_has_no_boundary_bonus uses fuzzy_match of x and caféx. The score is 16. The positions are 4. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Do not add a second case for coherence. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: fuzzy::tests::a_letter_after_an_accented_letter_has_no_boundary_bonus
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. fuzzy_match of x in caféx scores 24. After the change the score is 16 and the position is 4. The fullwidth hump score becomes 47.
